name: skill-registry
description: MCP server for searching, installing, and publishing Skills on a Skillset Registry.
long_description: Search a team's self-hosted Skillset Registry, install Skills into this project for the detected Agent, and publish a Skill to the Registry, from this project or from a repository you can clone. Reads need no credential; publishing needs a writer Token.

registry.title: Registry URL
registry.description: The self-hosted Skillset Registry to talk to.

token.title: Writer Token
token.description: Only needed to publish a Skill with publish_skill. Reads need no Token.
